story.summaryEn:
As the FIA's Global Fan Survey continues, some of touring car racing's ace drivers want you to share your views on the direction the discipline should take in the years ahead 👀
Have your say and help shape the future of touring car racing 📢
The survey remains open until 25 October 🚨
#FIA #FIAFanSurvey
detailZh:
随着FIA全球粉丝调查的持续进行，一些拉力赛车界的顶尖车手希望您分享对这项运动未来几年发展方向的观点 👀
说出您的看法，帮助塑造拉力赛车的未来 📢
调查将持续至10月25日 🚨
#FIA #FIAFanSurvey
